import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    first, _, rest = data.partition(b"\n")
    n, width = map(int, first.split()[:2])
    # Sentences are whole lines: keep leading/trailing spaces, never split on whitespace.
    lines = rest.split(b"\n")
    border = b"+" + b"-" * (width + 2) + b"+\n"
    out = sys.stdout.buffer
    for i in range(n):
        sentence = lines[i] if i < len(lines) else b""
        out.write(border + b"| " + sentence.ljust(width) + b" |\n")
    if n > 0:
        out.write(border)


main()
